prayerExcerpt.en-US: Released from slavery to sin, may we carry out in freedom of spirit what is pleasing to you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Abolida a escravidão do pecado, possamos livremente fazer o que vos agrada.

meta.face: A very old but wiry Catalan of about eighty with a sun-browned complexion and a small, compact, SHIELD-SHAPED face — a broad, bony forehead, high cheekbones angling down to a narrow, squared-off chin; a short, straight nose with a firm, rounded tip; small, bright black eyes set in fine laughter lines under bushy white brows; a long upper lip and a thin, wide mouth with a faint smile; a white Dominican crown of short hair around the shaven head; a close-cropped white beard only a finger deep, following the line of the jaw; the gaze lifted with serene confidence toward the sky ahead.
meta.basis: The painting on Wikipedia shows the tonsured, grey-bearded old friar sailing on his cappa with a staff and a key, the legend of his crossing from Mallorca to Barcelona; he died about a hundred years old in 1275. The small shield-shaped face and cropped beard are our choice to keep him from the long-bearded elders and from Albert the Great.
